errata.evidence: The English edition (10665-94830, p16 and pp30-31) recommends each strategy 'over' another, that is, in preference to it. The Persian edition renders 'over' as 'علاوه بر' (in addition to) in every recommendation of the expert panel's box on p16 (8 times) and again on pp30-31, which reads as recommending both strategies together.

narrative.text: The Persian edition translates the panel's 'use strategy X over strategy Y' as 'use X in addition to Y', turning a preference between two strategies into a recommendation to use both.
